newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: About 50 feared drowned as Bangladesh ferry sinks.
newsitem.headline: About 50 feared drowned as Bangladesh ferry sinks.

text.p: Nearly 50 people were feared drowned after a ferry carrying about 200 passengers sank in Bangladesh's flooded Jamuna river, police said on Wednesday.
The ferry capsized on Tuesday in a whirlpool near Sariakandi town in the northern district of Bogra, they said.
The remaining passengers were rescued by nearby boats, they said. Only seven bodies had been found but more than 40 were unaccounted for.
Police could provide no more details.
Last month more than 50 people drowned when a ferry capsized in Bangladesh's Dhanu river, northeast of Dhaka in what one policeman described as a "fierce whirlpool".
Flooding this month has killed more than 100 people in Bangladesh.
